verdict.rationale: 1Password documents an official Environments MCP Server that MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro can connect to, and a runtime probe confirmed a separate public docs MCP server completing an initialize handshake. However, the Environments server is labeled Beta, only manages Environments, and never returns secret values, so its agent-facing scope is limited. Missing for 10: general availability (non-Beta) status, MCP coverage of vaults and items beyond Environments, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The 1Password Environments MCP Server lets MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro securely manage your 1Password Environments.
The server can only see the names of your secrets and Environments, and never returns the actual secret values stored in your Environments
1Password's public docs MCP server at https://www.1password.dev/mcp completed a FULL keyless initialize handshake
